scenes.text: Imagine you are driving across a flat desert with absolutely nothing in sight for hundreds of miles.
The Tree of Ténéré was a sacred acacia and literally the loneliest tree on Earth, with no other trees living within two hundred and fifty miles.
But one day, a truck driver got drunk, lost control in the wide-open desert, and slammed directly into the historic tree, knocking it down.
Tell me in the comments if you think this was pure bad luck, and follow for more crazy history.
